8. Issue notice.

accepts notice; and seeks time to file reply.

11. Let status report/reply addressing inter-alia the aforesaid observation be filed within 03 weeks;
response/rejoinder, if any, be filed within 02 weeks thereafter; with copies to the opposing counsel.
12. Re-notify on 15th May 2026.
